overall_comment: Predictions are based only on the provided conventional MRI metadata. The absence of diffusion, perfusion, spectroscopy, and susceptibility/calcification-sensitive imaging limits molecular certainty, especially for 1p/19q status. Nevertheless, the very advanced age, large predominantly enhancing necrotic infiltrative mass, ependymal invasion, deep white matter invasion, and satellites strongly favor glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype, CNS WHO grade 4.
